profile.headline: GenAI Strategist Building Enterprise LLM Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building an enterprise-scale application using AI with a multi-agent architecture
Practicing XP while navigating a constantly changing landscape

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Increased the core workflow functionality of our SaaS integration platform by finding points of failure and re-designing Kafka message structure and flow. Eliminated hours of daily manual engineering work and protected major customers from churn. 
Modernized the internal admin console from Angular to React and added safeguards in the UI to decrease time spent on support and prevent loss of customer data.
Translated challenges into solutions for engineers building internal APIs and calling external APIs, by delivering a combination of vendor products and internally built applications. Researched, built POCs, designed, and delivered a Redocly developer portal and a Kong egress gateway to streamline both processes. Collaborated and communicated with both product experts and multiple cross-functional engineering teams to drive adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leveraged modern platforms such as Spring Boot on an enterprise-level to create new REST API endpoints, as well as integrated with and migrated legacy endpoints. 
Practiced both TDD and BDD to develop a greenfield project due to growing product markets. 
Contributed to a shift in multiple front-end projects from legacy to React/Redux, as well as creating additional functionality through new pages and components.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated on an IOT project that involved real-time monitoring for catastrophic home events.
Contributed to designing and building a SQL database, API’s using Spring Boot, and a UI using React/Redux. 
Practiced Agile methodologies as well as JUnit testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Practiced TDD while creating new API endpoints to add functionality and features for a customer-facing application used to set up and fulfill work orders for clients.
Created and optimized actors using the AKKA Actor framework for the message-driven application.
Leveraged AWS to store photos and other media.

positions.title: Immersive Technology Intern
positions.description:
Taught game development and 3D technology classes using Unity and Tinkercad to gifted students in a school for children with Autism. 
Contributed to applications in virtual reality for both adapted learning and therapy-related purposes. 
Presented information about the company and our growing class schedule to parents at special events.

honors.title: Scholarship Recipient
honors.issuer: Issued by Marine Corps Scholarship Foundation  · Aug 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: Technical Mentor for the “next generation of diverse leaders in tech,” supporting fellows in their skill-building journey toward sustainable and fulfilling engineering careers, moving from an average of $18k annual salary to nearly $90k.

Taught weekly classes to adults with developmental disabilities.
Planned activities that helped reach individuals' goals as well as help them learn valuable skills on popular devices.
